semantics.timing: Output reflects current inputs combinationally; no clock or cycle latency.
semantics.reset: No reset port or reset behavior.

numeric.behavior: Exact Boolean truth table; equivalent to odd parity of a,b,c,d.
numeric.arithmetic: No arithmetic accumulation, rounding, truncation, saturation or overflow.

verification.oracle: Independent lookup of the original map with Gray-order row and column conversion; do not compute expected values using the RTL parity equation.
verification.coverage: Exhaust all 16 binary input combinations, then revisit them in reverse order to check input changes.
verification.comparison: Case inequality after combinational settling; fatal on mismatch.
verification.tools: Icarus Verilog v12 with -g2012 and explicit dev_tb top, matching vvp; finite external timeouts.

specification_ambiguities: The original problem does not specify X/Z input behavior; verification covers binary inputs only.
